completeness.why: getUpcomingDates now passes its own skipWeekend field and mode to getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which decides whether to move the date (full). getNextDate calls it too but still computes the applies-flag with its own expression (strict comparison combined with noSkipWeekend) while the other caller passes its field, so it sits between full and partial and is scored partial. Both createScheduleList sites in schedule-template.ts keep their own skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date ternaries and were not touched.

interface.why: A trailing skipWeekend boolean defaulting to true on the date-arithmetic helper does carry the real variation and keeps old callers working, but the default lets callers (like the two untouched template sites) keep deciding outside it, and noSkipWeekend is folded into the boolean at the call site rather than made explicit.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic added; the remaining duplication is the untouched ternaries in server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList, which stay as they were.
